title: 2023 food defense plan and vulnerability assessment
source_system: FSQA document files; productivity suite file share
what_it_shows: Plan dated 2023-02-20 and signed by the General Manager. Scope is the smoked seafood process; the scope statement leaves out cold storage holding, outlet resale and inedible trim and keeps the seafood brine tank in. Worksheets cover 14 steps, each evaluated for a person with physical access, and name 4 actionable process steps; the brine and cure dosing skid, CIP valve control and smokehouse setpoints are not listed as steps. Mitigation strategies: badge access, a locked cure and ingredient room, CCTV at docks, visitor sign-in and escort. Monitoring is a weekly lock and seal check; corrective actions cover physical tampering; no verification section. A 2024 CCTV modification page has no signature. No reanalysis record after 2023
